note: Server-side content filter for user-generated text (#292, App Review guideline 1.2; docs/app-review-292.md, Decision 1). Each entry under `refuse` is a word or short phrase. Matching is on whole words after folding case, accents, look-alike digits and symbols, and spaced-out or run-together letters; substrings of longer words never match. `mask` names the fields where a match is replaced with asterisks instead of refused: chat, message, group, event, profile. A username is always refused. RIVER_OAKS_CONTENT_FILTER=off turns the filter off; RIVER_OAKS_CONTENT_FILTER_FILE points at a file of this shape that replaces this one. What this list holds is a content-policy choice for the operator.
refuse: i will find you and kill you
